steps.title: Welcome!
steps.purpose: Greet the child and set emotional tone
steps.owlText: Hello friend! Today we are going to play fun games with fractions! We will match, sort, and identify halves and quarters. Ready to play?
steps.studentText: Today we play fraction games! We match fractions to shapes and sort them.

media.altText: Owl teacher waving hello with game-style elements: shapes, fraction cards, and a score board
media.fallbackText: Owl teacher waving hello with game-style elements: shapes, fraction cards, and a score board

steps.title: Our Mission
steps.purpose: Tell the child what they will learn
steps.studentText: Today you will practice fractions by playing matching and sorting games. You will match fractions to shapes and sort shapes into halves and quarters!

steps.title: Think First!
steps.owlText: Before we play, think about this: What is a half? What is a quarter? How can you tell them apart? Remember: count the equal parts!
steps.studentText: What is a half? What is a quarter? How are they different? Think about it!

media.altText: Two shapes: one showing 1/2 and one showing 1/4, with a question mark between them
media.fallbackText: Two shapes: one showing 1/2 and one showing 1/4, with a question mark between them

interaction.question: What is the difference between one half (1/2) and one quarter (1/4)?
interaction.placeholder: One half is... and one quarter is...

steps.title: Learn It
steps.owlText: Let me show you how the games work. In the matching game, you see a fraction like 1/2 and you tap the shape that shows one half. In the sorting game, you drag shapes into the correct group: halves or quarters. Count the equal parts to know which is which!
steps.studentText: Game 1 — Matching: See a fraction, tap the correct shape. Game 2 — Sorting: Drag shapes into 'halves' or 'quarters' groups. Count the equal parts to decide!

media.altText: Game-style layout: fraction cards on one side, shapes on the other. Arrows show matching. Two sorting bins labeled 'halves' and 'quarters'.
media.caption: Match the fraction to the shape. Sort shapes into halves and quarters.
media.fallbackText: Game-style layout: fraction cards on one side, shapes on the other. Arrows show matching. Two sorting bins labeled 'halves' and 'quarters'.

steps.title: Real Life Connection
steps.purpose: Connect digital fraction practice to real life
steps.owlText: These games help you recognize fractions quickly! When you see a chapati cut in half, you will know it is 1/2. When you see a cake cut into 4 equal slices, you will know each slice is 1/4. The games train your eyes to spot fractions everywhere!
steps.studentText: Practicing fractions in games helps you recognize them in real life. Look for halves and quarters around you!

media.altText: Real objects: chapati cut in half (labeled 1/2), cake cut in 4 slices (labeled 1/4 each)
media.fallbackText: Real objects: chapati cut in half (labeled 1/2), cake cut in 4 slices (labeled 1/4 each)

steps.title: Watch and Learn
steps.purpose: Show worked example of fraction matching
steps.owlText: Let me show you. Here is the fraction 1/2. Which shape matches? This shape is divided into 2 equal parts with 1 shaded. That is one half! It matches. Here is 1/4. Which shape matches? This shape is divided into 4 equal parts with 1 shaded. That is one quarter! It matches.
steps.studentText: To match a fraction to a shape: Count the total equal parts. 2 parts = 1/2. 4 parts = 1/4. Find the shape that matches the fraction.

media.altText: Fraction cards: 1/2 and 1/4. Shapes below with matching arrows. One correct match shown.
media.fallbackText: Fraction cards: 1/2 and 1/4. Shapes below with matching arrows. One correct match shown.

steps.title: Your Turn!
steps.owlText: Now it is your turn! Play the matching game. Here is the fraction 1/4. Which shape shows one quarter? Tap the correct shape.
steps.studentText: Match the fraction to the shape. Which shape shows 1/4?

media.altText: Fraction card showing 1/4. Below: 4 shape options — one with 4 equal parts 1 shaded, others with different divisions.
media.fallbackText: Fraction card showing 1/4. Below: 4 shape options — one with 4 equal parts 1 shaded, others with different divisions.

interaction.question: Which shape shows one quarter (1/4)?
interaction.feedbackCorrect: Yes! Shape A has 4 equal parts with 1 shaded. That is one quarter!
interaction.feedbackIncorrect: Look for a shape with 4 equal parts. One of those parts should be shaded. That shows one quarter.

steps.title: Quick Check!
steps.owlText: Quick check! 2 children want to share a chapati fairly. What fraction does each child get?
steps.studentText: 2 children share one chapati fairly. What fraction does each child get?

media.altText: A chapati with 2 children beside it. The chapati is divided into 2 equal parts.
media.fallbackText: A chapati with 2 children beside it. The chapati is divided into 2 equal parts.

interaction.question: 2 children share one chapati fairly. What fraction does each child get?
interaction.feedbackCorrect: Correct! When 2 children share fairly, each gets one half. That is fair sharing!
interaction.feedbackIncorrect: If 2 children share one chapati fairly, we cut it into 2 equal parts. Each child gets 1 out of 2 parts. That is one half.

steps.title: Think About Your Learning
steps.owlText: You did great today! Think about what you learned. How do you match a fraction to a shape? How do you sort shapes into halves and quarters?
steps.studentText: What did you learn about fraction games today?

interaction.question: How do you feel about fraction games today?

steps.title: You Did It!
steps.owlText: Wonderful! You played fraction games today! You matched fractions to shapes and sorted them. Remember: count the equal parts to know the fraction. Keep practicing!
steps.studentText: You played fraction games! You can match and sort fractions!

media.altText: Celebration with stars and a badge that says 'I played fraction games!'
media.fallbackText: Celebration with stars and a badge that says 'I played fraction games!'
